test_case.test_name: Parameterized BlueField InfiniBand ib_write_bw300-second per-port validation
test_case.purpose: Measure RDMA write bandwidth independently on each designated BlueField InfiniBand port and prove no fabric/link/system error regression.
required_package: BlueField host/DPU endpoint, HCA/device/port, netdev/representor and GID/LID mapping
Peer endpoint, subnet/fabric path, link layer/rate/width/MTU and isolation
Per-port bandwidth, counter-delta, retry/error and host-health thresholds
test_case.test_command: For one approved port at a time, record both endpoints, HCA/port/GID/fabric state and authoritative IB/driver/port counters; start ib_write_bw server on the assigned endpoint and client from the distinct peer with explicit device/port/address and approved profile for300 seconds; retain complete two-ended output and telemetry; recapture counters and health, stop exact processes, then establish a fresh baseline before the next port.
test_case.expected_result: Every designated port independently meets its bound RDMA-write bandwidth and stability thresholds with acceptable IB/link counter deltas and healthy BlueField, peer and fabric state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact IB port/path/profile, complete two-ended evidence, per-port isolation and all approved thresholds. Ethernet counters alone, ambiguous HCA/port, truncated output, counter growth or unhealthy fabric is BLOCKED/FAIL.
safety_gate: Confirm isolated InfiniBand fabric path and distinct endpoints.
Verify HCA/port/GID/link-layer mapping before each run.
Abort on link flap, counter storm, thermal/CPU limit or production impact.
Stop only recorded processes and rebaseline between ports; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Authoritative pre/post IB/driver/link counters and system logs
Per-port threshold assessment, cleanup and final health
test_case.recovery: On fabric/path/link/host fault, stop exact test processes, preserve evidence, restore test-created settings and verify all involved IB ports/endpoints; do not substitute Ethernet validation or rerun automatically.
